verdict.rationale: Firebase documents several official SDKs: the Firebase Authentication SDK with sign-in and user-management methods, an Admin SDK that can trigger Cloud Functions, a Firebase Test SDK for rules and unit testing, and Firebase AI Logic client SDKs for Android, iOS, Flutter, Unity and web. Community users praise the libraries, including AngularFire, as a core strength. Missing for 10: a documented overview of SDK platform and language coverage for the core products, SDK reference or versioning documentation, and hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs beyond anecdotal praise.
